# Roots the effect preview sweeps: one path substring per line, `#` comments
# allowed. `PWE_PREVIEW_ROOTS` on the command line or a `workflow_dispatch`
# input overrides this file; nothing here changes how a root is drawn.
#
# This pass reads the particle sizes at Wraithgate (`绿鬼火3`, `骷髅光柱`), the
# Archosaur beam pair and the forest's axial cards, with the aquarium as the
# model-element control. The particle channel now prints the authored scale
# range, the keypoint the class actually applies and the world size that comes
# out, so "oversized" can be checked against the client's own product instead
# of the parsed half width.
天煞光束
树林光束
绿鬼火3
骷髅光柱
水族箱
蓝蘑菇2
# Element 101's `ZOffset` is a depth, not a translation (§59.1). This is the
# root with the largest offset in the pack — eleven cards at 2.6, 2.85 and 3.0 —
# and it is placed in this map at (2733.7, 223.8, -2708.3) and (2889.1, 223.7,
# -3048.3), so the cards' drawn extents can be measured either side of the fix.
暗语者营地
# The tile-mode control: four `TileMode: 1` sheets (`TexCol x TexRow` 3x2, 2x2,
# 1x1) scrolling V at -1.5/-1.8/-2.0, plus the `Warp` veil that must not draw.
# No other previewed root authors a tile, so without this line the tiled-UV law
# has no frame evidence at all — which is how the one-sheet window slipped
# through (§59.2).
水门_瀑布
# The other two waterfall classes the gate does not cover. 瀑布1 is an
# element-210 grid curtain (`A3DGridDecalEx`, authored lattice, `TexSpeed` V
# -0.5 on 连续水流纹理.tga), and 瀑布大 is the element-150 fractal veil: nine
# noise strips (Segs 10, three U speeds 0.30/0.35/0.45 on 气连续04.tga and
# 流动01_通道.dds, blend 5/6) plus its bound spray root. This map's world.ecwld
# places neither (its 31 waterfall placements are 水门_瀑布 x4 and the
# 瀑布水花* spray family only), so these two lines draw frames only when a map
# that installs them is swept; until then their runtime law is pinned by
# `the_shipped_waterfall_veil_fractals_scroll_their_sheets` in the pack-tests
# step. A line that matches no placement is skipped without a warning.
瀑布1
瀑布大
